title: About Us
content:

Every plan comes with clear Electricity Facts Labels, no hidden fees and rewards for paying on time.

title: Get to Learnin'
content:
Tips and guides for understanding your bill, saving energy and choosing a plan.

  • How to read an Electricity Facts Label
  • Keep your cool in extreme heat
  • What is energy choice?
  • How solar energy works

title: How to Read an EFL
content:
Every Texas plan has an Electricity Facts Label (EFL) showing the average price at 500, 1,000 and 2,000 kWh, the contract term and any fees.

Compare plans at the usage closest to your own monthly kWh.

title: Keep Your Cool in Extreme Heat
content: Set your thermostat to 78°F when home, close blinds during the afternoon and run ceiling fans counter-clockwise.

title: What Is Energy Choice
content: In deregulated areas of Texas you choose your electricity provider, while your local utility still delivers power and handles outages.

title: How Solar Energy Works
content: Solar panels turn sunlight into DC power; an inverter converts it to AC for your home. Extra power can be sold back with a buyback plan.

title: Giddy Up
content: Pick your own due date so your bill lines up with payday.
